statusText: Mapped policy state: WATCH. Tail 24 reflects confirmed Gulf escalation while NQ is closed; Sunday Gulf equities ended mixed and the U.S. denied Iran's disputed unmanned-vessel strike claim, leaving no live Nasdaq path evidence of persistent mean-reversion failure.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: WATCH. The Sunday Globex reopening is the next direct price-path checkpoint; any higher Tail state remains conditional on persistent one-way follow-through rather than headline importance alone.
headline: Mixed Gulf equities and U.S. denial keep closed-market Nasdaq Tail at WATCH 24
body: NQ remains closed. Reuters reports mixed Sunday Gulf equity markets amid continued U.S.-Iran tension, while Iran warned that further attacks would draw a faster and heavier response and the U.S. denied Iran's claimed strike on an unmanned American vessel. Friday's yield repricing and Gulf oil risk keep Stress extreme without live Nasdaq persistence evidence.

lookbackSummary: 14:00 UTC Saturday-13:00 UTC Sunday: Tail stayed in WATCH, easing to 21-23 overnight before returning to 24 from 08:00 UTC as fresh Hormuz escalation entered the closed-market assessment.
outlookSummary: Tail remains below the current block threshold while NQ is closed. Conditional Tail peaks at 34 at the 22:00 UTC Sunday reopening only if a directional gap is followed by shallow or failed retracements and reinforcing oil or yield pressure; Labor Day liquidity then argues for caution in interpreting isolated moves.

forecast.analysis: Immediately before regular Sunday Globex trading, headline sensitivity remains high. The next evidence test is whether any opening displacement repairs meaningfully or instead extends with shallow retracements.
drivers: Cross-asset confirmation is not yet observable

forecast.analysis: At the Sunday reopening, Tail is conditionally elevated only if a directional gap is followed by shallow or failed retracements and reinforcing oil or yield pressure. A two-sided open would invalidate this path.

forecast.analysis: During the second reopening hour, Tail remains elevated only if the initial move keeps extending after failed pullbacks or holds near an extreme. Meaningful retracement would lower the path quickly.
By midnight UTC, continued one-way efficiency would keep Tail elevated; if price discovery becomes two-sided and the opening gap repairs materially, the forecasted Tail should decay.
drivers: Two-sided price discovery would reduce Tail

forecast.analysis: In the early Asian session, persistent extension plus aligned cross-assets would sustain elevated Tail; orderly retracements or mixed confirmation would support faster normalization.
Later Asian trading shifts emphasis from the opening gap to retracement quality. Repeated failed pullbacks would sustain Tail; a broad two-way range would reduce pathological-path risk.
drivers: Repeated failed pullbacks would sustain Tail

forecast.analysis: Toward the Asia-Europe handoff, Tail remains above WATCH only under continued directional efficiency. Decaying volatility and successful mean reversion would undercut that scenario.
At the Europe handoff, the forecast returns to WATCH if the overnight path has shown meaningful retracements or conflicting cross-assets; unresolved one-way structure is the main invalidation.
European morning trading would carry high Stress but lower Tail if the reopening shock has been digested. Renewed energy or military escalation is the principal upside risk to this forecast.
drivers: Renewed energy or military escalation is the main upside risk

forecast.analysis: With U.S. cash markets closed for Labor Day, thinner holiday liquidity can amplify moves, but low participation alone is not proof of a no-retracement trend. Tail stays near WATCH absent persistent structure.
Mid-European morning risk remains dominated by holiday-thin futures liquidity and Gulf headlines. Tail falls further if the market retraces rather than extending directionally.
Into late European morning, a stable oil-and-yield complex plus two-sided NQ trade would support lower Tail. Fresh synchronized pressure would invalidate the easing path.
drivers: Fresh synchronized pressure would invalidate easing

forecast.analysis: Near midday Europe, the forecast assumes no new geopolitical discontinuity and no repeated extension after failed pullbacks. Stress remains high because headline sensitivity persists.
Early U.S. holiday hours lack a normal cash-open confirmation signal. Tail stays at the lower edge of WATCH unless futures independently show persistent directional efficiency.
drivers: Futures structure must stand on its own

forecast.analysis: Through the U.S. holiday morning, reduced participation lowers evidentiary quality. A quiet, mean-reverting futures path would support continued Tail normalization despite high background Stress.
By early U.S. afternoon, the forecast remains WATCH rather than green because geopolitical and rates risks persist, but without renewed one-way futures structure Tail remains contained.
Into the later U.S. holiday session, Tail remains at the lower edge of WATCH if futures continue to show two-sided trade. A fresh Gulf shock or repeated extension would be the main invalidation.
drivers: Fresh Gulf shock or repeated extension would invalidate easing
